roleTitle: Senior Project Manager, Plant Automation Retrofits
jobDescription: The plant automation retrofit programme replaces control systems in the company's bottling plants while they keep running. The Senior Project Manager is the accountable project manager of record on retrofit projects: signs the project charter and the stage-gate submissions, holds the project budget under the programme's delegated limits, runs the plant shutdown windows with the plant managers, and directs the project engineers assigned to the project. Prior experience as the project manager of record on retrofit or plant projects is required; workstream leadership under another project manager is not sufficient. Reports to the head of the retrofit programme; works with the plant managers, the automation vendor and the programme office.
requirements: Has been the project manager of record on plant or retrofit projects, signing the charter and the stage-gate submissions.
Holds the project budget under the programme's delegated limits.
Runs plant shutdown windows with the plant managers and directs the assigned project engineers.
Plans and tracks retrofit workstreams under the programme's stage-gate method.
Documents project boundaries, risks and hand-over conditions at each stage gate.

evidence.text: Project engineer, then workstream manager, on the bottling plant automation retrofit programme of a beverage group for five years, running the instrumentation and the control-panel workstreams within retrofit projects run by the programme's project managers.

Planned and tracked the two workstreams under the programme's stage-gate method, producing the workstream plans, the progress reports and the stage-gate inputs that the project manager of record assembled into the gate submissions.
Supported the plant shutdown windows at four plants as the workstream manager on site, with the shutdown plan and the shutdown decisions held by the project manager of record and the plant manager.
Wrote the workstream boundary notes, the workstream risk registers and the hand-over notes for each stage gate, all filed under the project manager of record's gate submissions.
Budget responsibility was limited to the workstream cost tracking against the allocation set by the project manager of record; no delegated spending limit was held.

Work sample: the instrumentation workstream plan and progress reports for one retrofit project, the workstream risk register and the hand-over note for gate three, with the programme office's document references as a verification trail; the gate submissions carry the project manager of record's signature.

Recruiter screen: candidate said he has been 'the senior PM in all but name' on the retrofits and that the projects 'were run by me day to day'; asked which charters or gate submissions he had signed, he said the project manager of record signed them 'because of the org chart'.

Hiring manager pre-read: the candidate's LinkedIn title reads 'Senior Project Manager, Plant Automation'; the head of the retrofit programme wants the packet to say who was project manager of record on each project and who held the budget.

propositions.text: The candidate has been a project engineer and then workstream manager on a beverage group's bottling plant automation retrofit programme for five years, running the instrumentation and control-panel workstreams within retrofit projects run by the programme's project managers.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the work sample document the roles, the years and the workstreams.

propositions.text: The candidate planned and tracked the two workstreams under the stage-gate method, supported the plant shutdown windows at four plants as the on-site workstream manager, tracked workstream cost against the allocation set by the project manager of record, and wrote the workstream boundary notes, risk registers and hand-over notes for each stage gate.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the work sample document the workstream planning, the shutdown support, the cost tracking and the gate documents.

propositions.text: The candidate has been the project manager of record on retrofit projects, signing the charters and the stage-gate submissions, holding the project budget and running the shutdown windows.
propositions.rationale: The resume places the candidate as workstream manager under the project manager of record, who signed the gate submissions, held the shutdown decisions and set the budget allocation; the senior PM standing comes from the screen and the LinkedIn title.

gold.expectedGap: The materials document workstream management under the project manager of record; they do not document the candidate as project manager of record, signing charters or gate submissions, holding the budget or running the shutdown windows.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the role as the resume states it: workstream manager under the project manager of record, with the gate submissions, budget and shutdown decisions held by that manager.
followUpTargets: Ask for the programme office's list of projects with the project manager of record for each, and any charter or gate submission signed by the candidate.
